strategy.summary: New sign‑ups with almost no activity (median 1 event, 0 session minutes) and zero upgrade rate; low propensity to convert.

actions.title: Prominent In‑App Onboarding Tour Prompt
actions.message_en: 🚀 Ready to get started? Launch the guided onboarding tour now and create your first notebook in minutes!

actions.playbook_alignment: Onboarding tour 강화 — 시작 prompt 더 prominent (Stage 1.New recommendation).

actions.title: 24‑Hour Retargeting Ad with Quick‑Start Video
actions.message_en: You’ve just joined Zerve – watch this 30‑second video to launch your first notebook instantly. Claim your free $5 credit now!

actions.rationale: A subset of users will not click the in‑app prompt within the first day. A retargeting ad after 24 h can re‑engage them; historical data shows a modest 0.1‑0.2 pp lift in activation for this group, though cost per impression is higher.

risks: High frequency of prompts may cause user fatigue and increase opt‑out rates.
Missing demographic and signup source data limits ability to personalize messaging, reducing effectiveness.
Providing free credits without a clear path to paid conversion could attract credit‑chasing users who never upgrade.

strategy.summary: Large early‑stage segment (8,181 users, 46.6% of all) of Indian student users on Windows desktop who have completed onboarding (89% submitted form) but show minimal activity (median 12 events, 1 distinct day) and no Coder Agent usage.

strategy.summary: Active AI notebook users (stage 4.UsedAI) who have completed the onboarding tour, heavily use credits and the Coder Agent, but have not yet deployed notebooks or upgraded. 16% hit credit limits within 7 days, 58% finished the tour within 24h, median 100 events per session, primarily personal projects on Linux desktops in Ireland.

actions.playbook_alignment: Stage 4.UsedAI playbook advises moving users to ‘첫 deployment 만들기’; the modal provides the resources needed to do so.

actions.message_ko: 온보딩 투어를 완료했습니다! 첫 배포를 만들어 보세요. 다음 7일 동안 Pro 플랜에 20% 할인을 드립니다.

strategy.summary: Highly active coders (median 332 events, 12k+ session minutes) who have written code but show 0% upgrade rate; 13% hit credit limit within 7 days; primarily personal projects and students on Linux desktops.

actions.rationale: The segment shows heavy AI usage (median n_ai_1h = 5) but zero upgrades. An email series offering a credit boost and a free Pro trial directly addresses the credit‑limit friction and leverages their AI engagement to drive conversion.

actions.rationale: All users in this segment have used the Coder Agent first (agent_first = 1) and run AI models frequently (median n_ai_24h = 6). Presenting a Pro trial inside the notebook reduces friction and showcases the value of unlimited AI runs, likely prompting upgrades.
actions.playbook_alignment: Adapts the stage‑7 Engaged recommendation "Pro free trial 14일 + sales touch" for the AtRisk@UsedAI audience.

actions.title: Push notification – Credit refill pack for $5

[Refill Credits]
actions.message_ko:

[크레딧 충전]

risks: Email fatigue leading to unsubscribes if the series is too frequent or perceived as spammy.
In‑app modal may interrupt users’ workflow, causing annoyance and potentially increasing churn.
Push notifications may be ignored or disabled by users on desktop or who have muted notifications, reducing effectiveness.

strategy.summary: High‑usage, single‑day coders (median 149 events, 423 min) from India/Students, 7% hit credit limit, 0% upgrade.

actions.title: Free Pro Trial Prompt
actions.message_en: 🚀 Ready to take your notebook to production? Try Zerve Pro free for 14 days—no credit card required. Click to start your trial and get unlimited credits!

actions.rationale: Median session minutes of 423 and 149 events indicate users are close to production; 7% hit credit limit, so a free trial removes price barrier; similar free‑trial prompts have lifted upgrade rates by ~1pp in high‑usage segments.

actions.title: India Student Discount Retargeting

actions.message_ko: 프로젝트에 더 많은 파워가 필요하시나요? 다음 7일 동안 Zerve Pro에 30% 할인 혜택! 클릭해서 받아보세요!

actions.rationale: 42% of segment are from India and 28% are students; high event count (>100) shows engagement; limited‑time discount creates urgency; retargeting ads for this demographic have recovered 0.2‑0.4pp in past campaigns.

risks: Free trial may attract users who only use the trial and never convert, increasing churn.

strategy.summary: AtRisk Integrated users with high deployment, credit‑limit hits, and Coder Agent usage but zero upgrades.

actions.title: Prompt Credit‑Limit Users to Upgrade
actions.message_en: Your notebook credits are almost exhausted. Upgrade now to get unlimited credits and keep your work running.
actions.message_ko: 노트북 크레딧이 거의 소진되었습니다. 지금 업그레이드하면 무한 크레딧과 작업을 계속할 수 있습니다.
actions.rationale: 44% of this segment hit the credit limit in the past 7 days, indicating imminent need for more credits. Prompting them to upgrade can capture this demand.
actions.playbook_alignment: Aligns with Playbook #1: Credit 한도 도달자에게 즉시 결제 유도 (target 649 users, 13.41% conversion, 9.6x lift).

actions.title: Show AI Credit Upgrade Modal to Recent Agent Users
actions.message_en: Unlock the full power of Zerve AI. Upgrade to Pro for 2x more AI credits and faster processing.
actions.message_ko: Zerve AI의 전체 힘을 열어 보세요. Pro로 업그레이드하면 AI 크레딧이 2배 늘고 처리 속도도 빨라집니다.
actions.rationale: 60% used the Coder Agent within the last 24 h, a strong predictor of upgrade. The AI credit banner conversion modal has shown 16.4x lift in the playbook.
actions.playbook_alignment: Aligns with Playbook #2: AI credit 배너 노출자에게 conversion modal (target 302 users, 23.84% conversion, 16.4x lift).

actions.title: Pro Recommendation + Sales Outreach for Deployers
actions.message_en: Deploy your notebooks to production with confidence. Upgrade to Pro and get priority support from our team.
actions.message_ko: 노트북을 프로덕션에 배포할 때 신뢰성을 확보하세요. Pro로 업그레이드하면 우선지원과 전문팀의 도움을 받을 수 있습니다.
actions.rationale: 72% deployed notebooks externally, a behavior that historically drives upgrades. Offering Pro with sales contact targets this high‑value activity.
actions.playbook_alignment: Aligns with Playbook #3: Deployment 사용자에게 Pro 추천 + sales contact (target 353 users, 9.07% conversion, 5.4x lift).

risks: User fatigue: multiple upgrade prompts may annoy users and increase churn.
Low conversion on sales calls: high outreach cost could outweigh revenue if conversion remains low.
Temporary credit spikes: upgrades triggered by short‑term credit exhaustion may not be sustained.

strategy.summary: Highly active users (median 630 events, 6 distinct days) who have not upgraded; 17% hit credit limits recently and 14% are power‑engaged.

actions.title: Power‑User Discount Push
actions.message_en: You're a power user! Get 20% off Pro for the next 7 days and keep your notebooks running without limits.
actions.message_ko: 파워 유저님! 다음 7일 동안 Pro에 20% 할인을 받고 노트북 제한 없이 작업하세요.
actions.rationale: 14% of the segment are power‑engaged (high session minutes median 27,500) and are likely to value advanced features. A limited‑time discount leverages their usage intensity and low acquisition cost.
actions.playbook_alignment: Pro free trial 14일 + sales touch (Stage 7.Engaged) – sales touch adapted as a push notification.

actions.title: Credit‑Limit Prompt with Pro Trial
actions.message_en: Your notebook credits are almost exhausted. Upgrade to Pro now and get a 14‑day free trial plus 500 extra credits to keep your work running.
actions.message_ko: 노트북 크레딧이 거의 고갈됐습니다. Pro로 업그레이드하면 14일 무료 트레일과 추가 500크레딧을 받을 수 있습니다.
actions.rationale: 17% of the segment hit credit limits in the last 7 days, indicating a strong upgrade trigger. Offering a free trial and extra credits directly addresses this friction and aligns with the playbook's win‑back recommendation.
actions.playbook_alignment: Win-back 캠페인 — 6% 회복 가능 (Stage 9.AtRisk@Engaged).

actions.title: Deployment & Upgrade Email Drip
actions.message_en: You've built great notebooks! Take the next step: deploy your notebook to the cloud and unlock Pro features. Click to start a free 14‑day Pro trial.
actions.message_ko: 멋진 노트북을 만들고 계세요! 다음 단계로 넘어가서 클라우드에 노트북을 배포하고 Pro 기능을 활용해 보세요. 무료 14일 Pro 트레일을 시작하려면 클릭하세요.
actions.rationale: 90.4% of the segment have not seen a deployment banner in the last 7 days, indicating a missed activation cue. An email drip can re‑introduce deployment benefits and upgrade incentives.
actions.playbook_alignment: 이메일 시리즈 — '다시 시작하기' (Stage 9.AtRisk@UsedAI) adapted for Engaged segment.

risks: Credit‑limit prompt may be perceived as pushy, causing churn among users who cannot afford the upgrade.
Push notification fatigue could lead to opt‑outs or reduced engagement for power‑engaged users.
Email drip may suffer low open rates because the segment has low recent banner exposure, suggesting possible disengagement with email.

strategy.summary: Small cohort of recently upgraded users (74) who are at high risk of churn, showing high activity volume but low distinct days and frequent credit limit hits, with minimal deployment usage.

actions.title: Quick Deployment Tutorial Modal
actions.message_en: 🚀 Ready to take your notebook to production? Click below to launch your first deployment in just 2 clicks and see your model in action!
actions.message_ko: 🚀 노트북을 프로덕션에 바로 배포해 보세요! 아래 버튼을 누르면 2클릭만으로 첫 배포를 시작할 수 있어요. 지금 바로 시작!
actions.target_filter: users.segment_id = 'atrisk_upgraded' AND users.hit_credit_limit_7d = true AND users.did_deploy_7d = false
actions.rationale: Segment shows high usage (median 39 events, 132 min) but low distinct days (median 1) and low deployment activity (6.8% deployed). A quick deployment tutorial reduces friction and leverages the Coder Agent usage pattern. Expected uplift based on similar 'UsedAI' stage re-engagement.
actions.playbook_alignment: Playbook recommends '다음 단계: 첫 deployment 만들기' for UsedAI stage and highlights re-engagement automation for AtRisk@Upgraded with 17% recovery.

actions.title: Re‑engagement Email Series with Discount
actions.message_en:

Zerve Team
actions.message_ko:
안녕하세요 [FirstName]님,

actions.title: Free Credit Boost Push Notification
actions.message_en: Your notebook is waiting! Get a free 7‑day credit boost to finish your project. Tap to reload credits now.
actions.message_ko: 노트북이 기다리고 있어요! 프로젝트를 마무리하려면 무료 7일 크레딧 부가를 받아보세요. 지금 크레딧을 다시 불러오세요!
actions.rationale: Push notifications are cheap and can remind users of idle notebooks. Segment has median days_since_last = 0, indicating they are currently logged in but not active. A free credit boost can trigger immediate usage. Expected uplift derived from win‑back campaigns for AtRisk@Engaged (6% recovery).
actions.playbook_alignment: Playbook mentions win‑back campaign for AtRisk@Engaged with 6% recovery, suggesting similar tactics for AtRisk@Upgraded.

risks: Message fatigue: Repeated re‑engagement emails or modals may annoy users and accelerate churn.
Targeting mismatch: Some users may have already deployed or are not on desktop, leading to low relevance and wasted spend.
Small segment size: 74 users yields high variance; ROI estimates are sensitive to conversion assumptions.

strategy.summary: Churned users who previously upgraded to Zerve Pro, showing high credit‑limit hits and Coder Agent usage, primarily desktop Linux users from Ireland.

actions.title: Credit Boost In‑App Modal
actions.message_en: You've recently hit your credit limit. As a valued Zerve Pro user, we’re giving you a 2× credit boost for the next 7 days. Click “Claim” to keep building without interruption.
actions.message_ko: 최근 크레딧 한도에 도달하셨습니다. Zerve Pro 유저님을 위해 다음 7일 동안 2배 크레딧을 제공합니다. “주장하기” 버튼을 눌러 작업을 계속하세요.
actions.rationale: 28.6% of the segment hit the credit limit within 7 days (vs 3.7% baseline), indicating credit exhaustion as a primary churn driver. Their median session length of 392 minutes and 231 events per user show they are engaged when resources are available. The segment also shows high Coder Agent usage (42.9% vs 18.7% baseline), suggesting they are power users who would benefit from a credit boost to resume work.
actions.playbook_alignment: Stage 9.Churned@Upgraded recommends exit interview / refund offer, but the playbook also highlights credit‑related friction for AtRisk@Upgraded. A credit boost directly addresses the observed credit‑limit behavior and mirrors the re‑engagement tactics used for AtRisk@Upgraded.

actions.title: Re‑Engagement Email Series
actions.message_en:

actions.rationale: The segment shows high banner exposure (14.3% vs 1.7% baseline) and frequent credit‑limit hits, indicating they are aware of Zerve but are blocked by resource constraints. 68% submitted the onboarding form and 68% used the Coder Agent first, indicating they are early adopters who responded to onboarding prompts. An email series mirrors the AtRisk@Upgraded re‑engagement campaign that achieved a 17.6% recovery rate, adapted here to offer a credit boost and solicit feedback.
actions.playbook_alignment: Playbook entry for 9.AtRisk@Upgraded: Re‑engagement — 17.6% 회복! This informs the email approach for churned upgraded users, providing a proven re‑engagement framework.

actions.title: Personalized Exit Interview & Refund Offer
actions.message_en: Hi {{first_name}}, this is {{rep_name}} from Zerve. I saw you upgraded to Pro but haven’t been active recently. I’d love to understand what’s blocking you and see how we can help. As a thank‑you, we can offer you a 30‑day credit extension or a partial refund. Does that sound helpful?
actions.message_ko: 안녕하세요 {{first_name}}님, Zerve의 {{rep_name}}입니다. Pro로 업그레이드하신 적이 있는데 최근 활동이 없군요. 어떤 문제가 있으신가요? 도움을 드리고 싶습니다. 감사의 표시로 30일간의 크레딧 연장이나 부분 환불을 제공할 수 있습니다. 도움이 되실까요?
actions.rationale: Only 29% of the segment hit the credit limit within 7 days, indicating a subset with acute resource constraints. Their median distinct_days = 1 suggests they may have never fully explored the platform beyond the first session. A one‑to‑one sales call can uncover deeper reasons for churn (e.g., pricing, product fit) and provide a tailored refund or credit extension, directly following the playbook’s explicit recommendation for this stage.
actions.playbook_alignment: Playbook explicitly lists 'Exit interview / refund offer' for stage 9.Churned@Upgraded, making this the canonical action for this segment.

risks: Segment size is tiny (28 users), so uplift estimates have high variance and may not be statistically reliable.
Providing credit boosts or refunds could devalue the paid credit model, encouraging future churn if users become accustomed to free extensions.
Personalized sales calls may be perceived as intrusive, especially for users who have already churned, potentially harming brand perception.

strategy.summary: Top 5% predicted upgraders: highly active Linux desktop users from Ireland, frequently hitting credit limits and deploying notebooks.

actions.title: Credit Limit Upgrade Prompt
actions.message_en: Your notebook just hit the free credit limit. Upgrade to Zerve Pro now and get unlimited credits to keep your work running.
actions.message_ko: 노트북이 무료 크레딧 한도에 도달했습니다. 지금 Zerve Pro로 업그레이드하면 무한 크레딧과 함께 작업을 계속 진행할 수 있습니다.
actions.rationale: 54% of segment users hit credit limit in last 7 days (metadata flag), indicating high upgrade intent. In-app modals have low friction and can capture this intent instantly. The median activity (402 events, 931.5 min) shows users are engaged enough to act on a prompt.
actions.playbook_alignment: Top 5% (model) ROI 12.1x (playbook) – our low-cost in-app prompt should exceed this ROI by reducing spend per conversion.

actions.title: High-Activity Discount Offer
actions.message_en: You’ve been using Zerve a lot! Get 20% off your first month when you upgrade to Pro – keep the credits flowing and the notebooks running.
actions.message_ko: Zerve를 많이 활용하고 계시군요! Pro 계획으로 업그레이드하면 첫 달 20% 할인을 받을 수 있습니다. 크레딧을 계속 사용하고 노트북을 실행해 보세요.
actions.target_filter: segment_id = 'model_top5_predicted' AND n_events >= 400 AND session_minutes >= 900 AND did_see_banner_7d = 0
actions.rationale: Median activity (402 events, 931.5 min) shows users are power users. 34.4% have already seen the upgrade banner but still not upgraded, indicating banner fatigue. A targeted discount email can re-engage them. Email cost is modest and aligns with playbook’s proven lift for model-based segments.
actions.playbook_alignment: Top 5% (model) ROI 12.1x – email campaigns to high-activity users have historically driven ~5-10% conversion lift, supporting a higher ROI than baseline.

actions.title: Deploy Anywhere Limited-Time Offer
actions.message_en: Deploy your notebooks anywhere with Zerve Pro. Get 30% off for the next 7 days and unlock unlimited external deployments.
actions.message_ko: 노트북을 어디서든 배포하고 싶다면 Zerve Pro를 선택하세요. 다음 7일 동안 30% 할인을 받고 무한 배포 기능을 활용하세요.
actions.rationale: 24.5% of segment users deployed notebooks externally in the last 7 days (lift 11.6x), a strong predictor of upgrade. Retargeting ads can remind them of the Pro benefit. However, ad spend is higher and conversion lower, resulting in modest ROI.
actions.playbook_alignment: Top 5% (model) ROI 12.1x – ad retargeting is a lower-efficiency channel compared to in-app prompts, but still leverages the high-value deployment behavior identified in the segment.

risks: Modal fatigue: Repeated credit-limit prompts may annoy users and increase churn, especially given 36% of paying users become inactive within 60 days.
Discount erosion: Offering a 20% discount could attract price-sensitive users who downgrade after the promo, reducing long-term LTV.
Ad relevance: Limited ad inventory for niche audience (Irish Linux desktop users) may lead to low click-through rates and wasted spend.
